nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a finite field with $q$ elements and let $a_1, \dots, a_q \in K$. Then $a_1, \dots, a_q$ are pairwise distinct if and only if $\sum_{i=1}^{q} a_i^t = 0$ for every $t = 0, 1, \dots, q - 2$ and $\sum_{i=1}^{q} a_i^{q-1} = -1$, where $0^0 = 1$.

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field, $f \in F[X]$ and $k$ a natural number. Then $f$ is complete to level $k$ if and only if for every natural number $i \le k$ the map $F \to F$, $x \mapsto (f + iX)(x)$, is bijective, where $i$ is viewed as an element of $F$.

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field, $f \in F[X]$ and $k$ a natural number. If $f$ is complete to level $k$, then $f$ is a permutation polynomial.
nodes.title: A $k$-complete polynomial is a permutation polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field, $f \in F[X]$ and $k$ a natural number. Then $f$ is complete to level $k + 1$ if and only if $f$ is complete to level $k$ and $f + (k + 1)X$ is a permutation polynomial, where $k + 1$ is viewed as an element of $F$.

nodes.title: Completeness at level zero

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field, $f \in F[X]$ and $k$ a natural number. The polynomial $f$ is complete to level $k$ ($k$-complete) when $f + iX$ is a permutation polynomial for every natural number $i \le k$, where $i$ is viewed as an element of $F$.
nodes.title: Polynomial complete to level $k$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $k, t, a$ be positive integers with $p \nmid a$, $\gcd(a, p - 1) = 1$ and $k \equiv 1 \pmod{p(p-1)}$. Suppose that $p - 1 \nmid t$ or $p^2 \mid k - 1$. nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a finite field with $q$ elements and let $d \ge 1$ be an integer. Then $X^d$ is a permutation polynomial of $K$ if and only if $\gcd(d, q - 1) = 1$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
